tip_1_description: The choice of the name Jami was inspired by the Swahili word “jamii”, which means “community” as a noun and “together” as an adverb.
tip_2_title: What is the green dot next to my account?
tip_2_description: A red dot means that your account is disconnected from the network; it turns green when it's connected.
tip_3_title: Why should I back up my account?
tip_3_description: Jami is distributed and your account is only stored locally on your device. If you lose your password or your local account data, you WILL NOT be able to recover your account if you did not back it up earlier.
tip_4_description: In a call, you can click on “Invite members” to add a contact to a call.
tip_5_description: A Jami account is an asymmetric encryption key. Your account is identified by a Jami ID, which is a fingerprint of your public key.
tip_6_title: What information do I need to provide to create a Jami account?
tip_6_description: When you create a new Jami account, you do not have to provide any private information like an email, address, or phone number.
tip_7_title: Why don’t I have to use a password?
tip_7_description: With Jami, your account is stored in a directory on your device. The password is only used to encrypt your account in order to protect you from someone who has physical access to your device.
tip_8_title: لماذا لست مضطرًا لتسجيل اسم مستخدم؟
tip_8_description: The most permanent, secure identifier is your Jami ID, but since these are difficult to use for some people, you also have the option of registering a username.
tip_9_title: How can I back up my account?
tip_9_description: In Account Settings, a button is available to create a backup of your account.
tip_10_title: What happens when I delete my account?
tip_10_description: Your account is only stored on your own devices. If you delete your account from all of your devices, the account is gone forever and you CANNOT recover it.
tip_11_title: Can I use my account on multiple devices?
tip_11_description: Yes, you can link your account from the settings, or you can import your backup on another device.
